items.title: Amsterdam > Delft > Den Haag > Rotterdam
items.heroTitle: Four Dutch cities in four days.
items.heroDescription: Amsterdam canals, Delft pottery, Den Haag's seaside boulevard and Rotterdam's modern skyline — all reachable by train.
items.summary: A compact Dutch circuit connecting Amsterdam, Delft, Den Haag and Rotterdam by rail, with city walks and museum mornings.
highlights: Amsterdam canal walk at golden hour

items.title: Amsterdam-Zaanse Schans, Edam, Volendam and Marken Tour
items.heroDescription: A classic Dutch day tour from Amsterdam to Zaanse Schans windmills, Edam cheese market, Volendam harbour and Marken island.
items.summary: One day of Dutch icons: wooden windmills, cheese tasting, fishing villages and the island of Marken, all within an hour of Amsterdam.

items.title: Roermond Shopping & Utrecht Day Trip
items.heroDescription: Morning shopping at Roermond Designer Outlet, afternoon exploring Utrecht's canals and wharf cellars.
items.summary: A day of retail therapy at Roermond Designer Outlet followed by a stroll through Utrecht's historic centre and canal wharves.

items.title: From Amsterdam by Train: Delft & The Hague Small-Group Tour
items.heroDescription: A small-group train trip from Amsterdam to Delft's historic centre and Den Haag's beachfront boulevard.
items.summary: A guided small-group day tour by train from Amsterdam to Delft and Den Haag, with pottery workshops and seaside walks.

items.title: Bruges Day Trip from Amsterdam
items.heroDescription: A day trip by train from Amsterdam to Bruges, with canal walks, Belfry views and Belgian chocolate tasting.
items.summary: One day in medieval Bruges: canal-side strolls, Belfry tower climb, and chocolate and waffle tastings in the Markt square.

items.title: Amsterdam to Utrecht Day Trip: Gouda and Den Bosch
items.heroDescription: A day from Amsterdam to Utrecht, with stops in Gouda for cheese and Den Bosch for its historic centre and cathedral.
items.summary: A Dutch city circuit from Amsterdam: Gouda cheese market, Utrecht's canal wharves, and Den Bosch's St. John's Cathedral.

items.title: Giethoorn, Netherlands
items.heroDescription: Giethoorn's car-free village with thatched-roof farms, wooden bridges and whisper-quiet canals explored by whisper boat.
items.summary: A day in Giethoorn, the car-free village of canals and wooden bridges, explored by electric whisper boat and on foot.

items.title: Maastricht, Netherlands
items.heroDescription: Two nights in Limburg's oldest city: caves, basilicas, and the southern Burgundian food and wine culture.
items.summary: A weekend in Maastricht: St. Servaas Basilica, the underground caves, Vrijthof square and Burgundian dinners with local wines.

items.title: Valkenburg
items.heroDescription: A day in Limburg's Valkenburg: castle hill ruins, marlstone caves and the historic town centre.
items.summary: One day in Valkenburg: Velvet Cave and Municipal Cave tours, castle ruins on the hill and a walk through the marlstone town.
highlights: Velvet Cave and Municipal Cave tour

items.title: Antwerp, Belgium
items.heroDescription: Two nights in Antwerp: the cathedral, the diamond district, fashion boutiques and Rubens House.
items.summary: A weekend in Antwerp: Onze-Lieve-Vrouwekathedraal, the diamond district, shopping on Meir and Rubens House museum.

items.title: Ghent, Belgium
items.heroDescription: Two nights in Ghent: Gravensteen castle, St. Bavo's Cathedral and the Graslei canal at twilight.
items.summary: A weekend in Ghent: Gravensteen medieval castle, St. Bavo's with the Adoration of the Mystic Lamb, and canal-side dining.
highlights: St. Bavo's Cathedral and Mystic Lamb

items.title: Aachen, Germany
items.heroDescription: A day trip to Aachen: the UNESCO cathedral, historic town hall and the famous Elisenbrunnen spa fountain.
items.summary: One day in Aachen: Charlemagne's cathedral, the Elisenbrunnen thermal springs and the old town market square.

items.title: Christmas Trip: Valkenburg & Aachen
items.heroDescription: A festive two-night trip to Valkenburg's Christmas market in the caves and Aachen's Christmas market, with glühwein and stollen.
items.summary: A Christmas getaway: Valkenburg's underground Christmas market in the marlstone caves and Aachen's historic Christmas market.
highlights: Valkenburg Christmas market in the caves
